extension.description: Installs the private KingBlap Kodi build using an access code, enables packaged add-ons, sets and refreshes Gismeteo for Thomasville, North Carolina, removes the OnePlay repository, and applies Xonfluence 6.0.7 after installation and on Kodi startup.
extension.disclaimer: Enter the access code supplied by KingBlap in the add-on settings. The build excludes personal accounts, provider credentials, media libraries, databases, and caches. Enter your own service credentials after installation.
